svg.text: 13 implemented PostgreSQL tables • All base-schema attributes • No embeddings table
A. Entity and attribute panels — each oval contains exactly one attribute
B. Relationship panels — repeated rectangles refer to the SAME entities above
1 / N = maximum cardinality · double line = total participation · single line = partial participation
All M:N associations are reified consistently: e.g. USERS 1—N USER_SKILLS N—1 SKILLS.
Each associative row participates totally in both parent relationships; parent participation is partial unless stated otherwise.
RESOURCES participates totally in PRIMARY_SKILL (exactly one skill) and TEACHES (primary coverage maintained by triggers).
HAS_PATH uses composite FK learning_paths(user_id, goal_id) → user_active_goals(user_id, goal_id).
LEARNING_PATH_ITEMS: UNIQUE(path,resource), UNIQUE(path,sequence_order). Underlined attributes form the primary key.
MongoDB: resources.mongo_content_id stores the document ID; resource_contents.resource_id stores resources.id.
Descriptions, objectives, modules, chapters, notes and tags live in MongoDB. This is an application link, not a foreign key.
ALTER overlay: resources gains one separate attribute, last_reviewed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), only after alter-demo.sql is applied.
